dispersion_definition: per-cell local covariance of same-session RF centers using 15-degree RF-space Gaussian weights, computed before translation; no CCF coordinates enter the registration

controls.support_matched_shuffle: exact RF centers retained; covariance descriptors permuted across those centers independently in full and split target sets
controls.ccf: post hoc association only; 250-um 3D CCF-neighborhood RF covariance
